نجلعب (form IVq)
# نَجْلَعِبُّ (najlaʕibbu) /nad͡ʒ.la.ʕib.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِجْلَعَبَّ (ijlaʕabba)
# نَجْلَعِبَّ (najlaʕibba) /nad͡ʒ.la.ʕib.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِجْلَعَبَّ (ijlaʕabba)
# نَجْلَعِبِّ (najlaʕibbi) /nad͡ʒ.la.ʕib.bi/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِجْلَعَبَّ (ijlaʕabba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
